answer.because: The first run's 1428.5 profit is measured with five dead trail inputs and a take profit locked to the entry close; repair the exit section to the desk style before tuning.
answer.script:
//@version=5
strategy("Day Shift 9k Smart Trail + POC Delta Combined dual time Redesign 1", overlay=true,
  initial_capital=50000, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1,
  commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract, commission_value=5.50,
  slippage=1, pyramiding=0, process_orders_on_close=true, calc_on_every_tick=false,
  max_bars_back=5000, max_labels_count=500)
// ===== RISK =====
pv                = input.float(5, "Point Value ($)")
stop_dollars      = input.int(250, "Stop ($)", minval=250, maxval=700)
tp_dollars        = input.int(500, "Take Profit ($)", minval=250)
long_stop = strategy.position_size > 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price - stop_dollars / pv : close - stop_dollars / pv
long_limit = close + tp_dollars / pv
short_stop = strategy.position_size < 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price + stop_dollars / pv : close + stop_dollars / pv
short_limit = close - tp_dollars / pv
if strategy.position_size != 0 and not na(stop_dollars)
    if strategy.openprofit <= -stop_dollars
        strategy.close_all(comment="Open P&L > SL Risk")

// ===== INPUTS =====
profile_lookback  = input.int(120, "Profile Lookback (bars)", minval=20, maxval=2000, step=10)
profile_rows      = input.int(10, "Price Levels (rows)", minval=5, maxval=100, step=5)
min_delta_pct     = input.float(10.0, "Min Delta Imbalance (%)", minval=0, maxval=80, step=5)
vwma_len          = input.int(50, "Trend VWMA Length", minval=1, maxval=500)
pivot_left        = input.int(3, "Pivot Left Bars", minval=2, maxval=21, step=1)
pivot_right       = input.int(3, "Pivot Right Bars", minval=2, maxval=21, step=1)
use_reversal      = input.bool(true, "Use Reversal Trade")
use_session       = input.bool(true, "Use Session Filter")
sess_start_hr     = input.int(18, "Session Start Hour (ET)", minval=0, maxval=23)
sess_start_mn     = input.int(0,  "Session Start Minute", minval=0, maxval=59)
sess_end_hr       = input.int(16, "Session End Hour (ET)", minval=0, maxval=23)
sess_end_mn       = input.int(0,  "Session End Minute", minval=0, maxval=59)

// ===== RISK CALCULATIONS =====

// ===== SESSION LOGIC =====
bar_hr = hour(time, "America/New_York")
bar_mn = minute(time, "America/New_York")
bar_t  = bar_hr * 100 + bar_mn
int s_start = sess_start_hr * 100 + sess_start_mn
int s_end   = sess_end_hr * 100 + sess_end_mn

bool in_session = not use_session or (s_start > s_end ? (bar_t >= s_start or bar_t < s_end) : (bar_t >= s_start and bar_t < s_end))

prev_hr = hour(time[1], "America/New_York")
prev_mn = minute(time[1], "America/New_York")
prev_t  = prev_hr * 100 + prev_mn
bool was_in_session = not use_session or (s_start > s_end ? (prev_t >= s_start or prev_t < s_end) : (prev_t >= s_start and prev_t < s_end))
bool session_ended = was_in_session and not in_session

if session_ended and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="Session Close")

// ===== VOLUME PROFILE WITH DELTA =====
int lb   = math.min(profile_lookback, bar_index)
int rows = profile_rows

float prof_hi   = ta.highest(high, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_lo   = ta.lowest(low, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_span = prof_hi - prof_lo
float step_size = prof_span > 0 ? prof_span / rows : na

var array<float> vol_total = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_up    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_dn    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)

float poc_price     = na
float poc_hi        = na
float poc_lo        = na
float poc_delta_pct = na
int   poc_row       = 0

if not na(step_size) and prof_span > 0 and lb > 1
    for a = 0 to 2
        arr = a == 0 ? vol_total : a == 1 ? vol_up : vol_dn
        if arr.size() != rows
            arr.clear()
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                arr.push(0.0)
        else
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                arr.set(i, 0.0)

    for iBar = 0 to lb - 1
        float bar_vol = volume[iBar]
        if bar_vol <= 0
            continue

        float bar_lo = low[iBar]
        float bar_hi = high[iBar]
        bool  bar_up = close[iBar] >= open[iBar]

        int s_row = math.max(math.floor((bar_lo - prof_lo) / step_size), 0)
        int e_row = math.min(math.floor((bar_hi - prof_lo) / step_size), rows - 1)
        int span  = e_row - s_row + 1

        if span <= 0
            continue

        float per_row = bar_vol / span
        for k = 0 to span - 1
            int r = s_row + k
            if r >= 0 and r < rows
                vol_total.set(r, vol_total.get(r) + per_row)
                if bar_up
                    vol_up.set(r, vol_up.get(r) + per_row)
                else
                    vol_dn.set(r, vol_dn.get(r) + per_row)

    float max_vol = 0.0
    for r = 0 to rows - 1
        float v = vol_total.get(r)
        if v > max_vol
            max_vol := v
            poc_row := r

    poc_price := prof_lo + (poc_row + 0.5) * step_size
    poc_lo    := prof_lo + poc_row * step_size
    poc_hi    := prof_lo + (poc_row + 1) * step_size

    float poc_up_vol = vol_up.get(poc_row)
    float poc_dn_vol = vol_dn.get(poc_row)
    float poc_tot    = vol_total.get(poc_row)
    poc_delta_pct    := poc_tot > 0 ? ((poc_up_vol - poc_dn_vol) / poc_tot) * 100 : 0.0

// ===== TREND FILTER =====
float vwma_val = ta.vwma(close, vwma_len)

// ===== POC BREAKOUT SIGNALS =====
bool above_poc = not na(poc_hi) and close > poc_hi and close[1] <= poc_hi
bool below_poc = not na(poc_lo) and close < poc_lo and close[1] >= poc_lo

bool delta_bull = min_delta_pct <= 0 or (not na(poc_delta_pct) and poc_delta_pct > min_delta_pct)
bool delta_bear = min_delta_pct <= 0 or (not na(poc_delta_pct) and poc_delta_pct < -min_delta_pct)

// ===== PIVOT POINT CONFIRMATION =====
float ph = ta.pivothigh(high, pivot_left, pivot_right)
float pl = ta.pivotlow(low, pivot_left, pivot_right)

// ===== ARM ON POC BREAKOUT, ENTER ON PIVOT =====
var int armed_dir = 0

if above_poc and close > vwma_val and delta_bull
    armed_dir := 1
else if below_poc and close < vwma_val and delta_bear
    armed_dir := -1

if armed_dir == 1 and not na(poc_hi) and not na(poc_lo)
    if close <= poc_hi
        armed_dir := 0
else if armed_dir == -1 and not na(poc_hi) and not na(poc_lo)
    if close >= poc_lo
        armed_dir := 0

bool pivot_confirm_long  = armed_dir == 1 and not na(ph)
bool pivot_confirm_short = armed_dir == -1 and not na(pl)

bool long_sig  = pivot_confirm_long and in_session and strategy.position_size <= 0
bool short_sig = pivot_confirm_short and in_session and strategy.position_size >= 0

// ===== ENTRIES =====
var int last_dir        = 0
var bool reversal_pending = false
var bool is_reversal     = false

if long_sig
    last_dir        := 1
    is_reversal     := false
    armed_dir       := 0
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
    strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)
else if short_sig
    last_dir        := -1
    is_reversal     := false
    armed_dir       := 0
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
    strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)

// ===== RESET AFTER TRADE — detect stop loss for reversal =====
if strategy.position_size == 0 and strategy.position_size[1] != 0
    armed_dir       := 0
    if use_reversal and not is_reversal and last_dir != 0
        int idx = strategy.closedtrades - 1
        if idx >= 0 and strategy.closedtrades.profit(idx) < 0
            reversal_pending := true
    is_reversal := false

// ===== REVERSAL TRADE =====
if use_reversal and reversal_pending and strategy.position_size == 0 and in_session
    reversal_pending := false
    is_reversal      := true
    if last_dir == 1
        last_dir     := -1
        strategy.entry("RevShort", strategy.short)
        strategy.exit("XRS", "RevShort", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)
    else if last_dir == -1
        last_dir     := 1
        strategy.entry("RevLong", strategy.long)
        strategy.exit("XRL", "RevLong", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)

// ===== RESEND EXIT ORDERS =====
if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)
    strategy.exit("XRL", "RevLong", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)
else if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)
    strategy.exit("XRS", "RevShort", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)

// ===== PLOTS =====
plot(vwma_val, "VWMA", color=color.blue, linewidth=1)
float ppoc = not na(poc_price) ? poc_price : na
float phi  = not na(poc_hi) ? poc_hi : na
float plo  = not na(poc_lo) ? poc_lo : na
plot(ppoc, "POC", color.yellow, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=1)
plot_hi = plot(phi, "POC High", #2962FF, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=2)
plot_lo = plot(plo, "POC Low", #2962FF, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=2)
fill(plot_lo, plot_hi, color=color.new(color.blue, 90))
plot(strategy.position_size != 0 ? (strategy.position_size > 0 ? long_stop : short_stop) : na, "Stop", color.fuchsia, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=2)
plotshape(long_sig, "Long Signal", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.lime, size=size.small)
plotshape(short_sig, "Short Signal", style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.red, size=size.small)
